verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਵਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਦਾਦਰ ਕਮਲ ਗਤਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਦ ਗਤਿ ਅੰਤਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saravar mai na jaanee dhaadhar kamal gat mirag mirag madh gat a(n)tar na jaanee hai ||

en.bdb: A frog living in a pool is unaware of the presence of a lotus flower growing in the same pool. Even a deer is unaware of the musk pod that he is carrying within his body.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਣਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਅਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਖਮ ਕੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ ਸੰਖ ਨਿਧਿ ਹੀਨ ਬਕ ਬਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: man mahimaa na jaanee eh bikh bikham kai saagar mai sa(n)kh nidh heen bak baanee hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a poisonous snake because of its poison is not aware of the invaluable pearl that he carries in his hood and a conch shell keeps wailing although it lives in the ocean but unaware of the wealth stored therein.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਂਸ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਉਲੂਐ ਅਲਖ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨਕਰ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan sameep jaise baa(n)s niraga(n)dh ka(n)dh ulooaai alakh dhin dhinakar dhiaanee hai ||

en.bdb: As a bamboo plant remains bereft of fragrance despite living in the close proximity of a Sandalwood tree, and as an owl keeps his eyes shut during the day behaving ignorantly of the Sun,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਬਾਂਝ ਬਧੂ ਮਮ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਭੇਟਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸੇਬਲ ਜਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੩੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise baa(n)jh badhoo mam sree gur purakh bheT nihachal sebal jiau haumai abhimaanee hai ||236||

en.bdb: Similarly, because of my ego and pride, I like an infertile woman remained fruitless despite acquiring the touch of True Guru. I am no better than the tall fruitless tree like silk Cotton. (236)
